latest_release.name: OpenTune v1.1.0
latest_release.body:
OpenTune 1.1.0 is a large update: a Home that is built from what you play, Automix, bit-perfect output, a separate app for TVs, and a long list of redesigns and fixes.

**Home**
- Home's rows are ordered by how often you play from each, with a little shuffle each day. Mix rows no longer come one after another.
- Your daylist, a mix that changes through the day, shown as a large card over its own blurred covers.
- Mixes by genre, and a Discover mix for each of your top genres. They are kept for 12 hours instead of changing every time Home opens.
- Listening streaks and badges, and a first-run artist picker.
- Cards that YouTube Music repeats across shelves are shown once.
- Mixes can download by themselves on Wi-Fi while the phone charges.

**Playback**
- Automix: songs blend into each other, matched in key and tempo. It waits for the vocals to end and skips silent endings. Choose how much work it does under Settings.
- Crossfade without the gap or the repeated bit.
- Autoplay keeps the queue filled, so it never runs dry with Next greyed out.
- Bit-perfect output through OpenTune's own USB DAC driver, exclusive access to the built-in DAC, and the headphone jack, multichannel as well as stereo.
- Every song shows its bitrate, measured from the audio. Dolby Atmos (E-AC-3 and AC-4) is recognised.
- A performance profile with a battery saver.

**New features**
- OpenTune for TV is now its own app (`OpenTune-TV-v1.1.0.apk`), with sign-in from your phone. Your phone can also act as its remote, with a trackpad and buttons.
- Comments on the playing song, from YouTube.
- Smart playlists that fill themselves from rules.
- Free audiobooks from LibriVox, with chapters and your place kept.
- Pick several songs at once to like, queue, download or add to a playlist.
- Add songs to several playlists at once. Untick a playlist to take the song out of it.
- Liked songs sync with YouTube Music both ways, and YouTube Music listens come into your history.
- Discord shows what you're playing.
- An App language setting. Translations are still being filled in.

**Design**
- Redesigned Add to playlist, Fonts & readability, Account & integrations, Audio sources, Followed artists and the artist signature card.
- Playlist and artist lists open tall and pull up to full page. Comments, Followed artists and Add to playlist go edge to edge.
- Player backgrounds in the cover's own colours, full-screen playlist covers, and a smoother player opening and fold.
- The player's three-dot menu has one icon per row, and Comments is always there.
- Saved playlists can be removed from your library.

The desktop app and the web player carry this release's shared changes. The web player also has a Back button and a title bar on album and playlist pages, and covers on the mood and genre tiles.

Install over the official app to keep your settings. Choose **arm64-v8a** for most recent phones or **universal** if unsure. The release uses the official signing identity; `SHA256SUMS.txt` contains APK checksums.

# OpenTune A free music player for the YouTube Music catalogue, with no ads, no account and no subscription. It runs on Android phones and TVs, Windows, macOS, Linux and in the browser. Sign in only if you want your likes and playlists.

## Get it | Where | How | |---|---| | **Android phone or tablet** | Download the APK from the [latest release](https://github.com/justshivv/Opentune/releases/latest), open it and allow the install. Android 8.0 or newer. | | **Android TV, Google TV** | Install `OpenTune-TV-.apk` from the [releases](https://github.com/justshivv/Opentune/releases) and sign in by scanning a code with your phone. [More](docs/install.md#android-tv) | | **Windows, macOS, Linux** | Desktop builds are attached to the [latest release](https://github.com/justshivv/Opentune/releases/latest). | | **Browser** | Open the [web player](https://justshivv.github.io/Opentune/player/). It needs a small companion extension. [More](docs/install.md#web-player-preview) | | **iPhone, iPad** (early build) | Through SideStore or AltStore, with your own Apple ID. [Steps](docs/install.md#iphone-and-ipad) | On Android, `arm64-v8a` fits almost every recent phone and `universal` runs on anything. Each release lists the SHA-256 checksums of its files, and the app checks for updates once a day and can update itself. ## What it does **Listening** - Plays the best stream it can find, and upgrades mid-song without a gap. - Crossfade and Automix, loudness levelling, a 15-band equalizer and AutoEq corrections for more than 8,000 headphones. - Bit-perfect output to a USB DAC on Android 14 and newer. - Lossless audio from add-ons you choose to connect. [How add-ons work](docs/audio-addons.md) - Offline downloads, and the music files already on your phone. **Lyrics** - Synced lyrics lit word by word, from several sources, that also work offline. - Tap a line to jump there, or share the lines you love as a picture or a video. **Beyond music** - Live radio from more than 50,000 stations, nearest first. - Podcasts and audiobooks that pick up where you stopped. - Listen together: share a room code and friends hear the same song in step. **Your library** - Likes, playlists, smart playlists, daily mixes and Replay stories. - Import from Spotify and YouTube playlists; scrobble to Last.fm and ListenBrainz. - Your own music server (Subsonic). **Look and feel** - A player that takes its colours from the cover, in seven layouts, from a full-screen cover to vinyl, cassette and a glowing halo. - Light, dark and pure black themes, accent colours, Liquid Glass, and 36 languages. **Around the phone** - Cast to Chromecasts, TVs and network speakers; Android Auto; a home-screen widget. - Name that song: hold the phone up and it tells you what's playing. - Your phone as the remote for the TV app. The full list, with how each part works, is in [docs/features.md](docs/features.md). ## Documentation | | | |---|---| | [Features](docs/features.md) | Everything the app does, in detail | | [Installing](docs/install.md) | iPhone and iPad, Android TV and the web player, step by step | | [Audio add-ons](docs/audio-addons.md) | Connecting your own lossless sources | | [Android TV](docs/android-tv.md) | The TV app and the phone remote | | [Appearance options](docs/appearance-options.md) | Themes, layouts and glass | | [Languages](docs/languages.md) | Translations and how to add one | | [Service integrations](docs/service-integrations.md) | Last.fm, Discord and build-owner setup | | [Usage counts](docs/usage-counts.md) | What the app reports, and what it never does | | [Building](docs/building.md) | Building from source, CI, releases and the project layout | ## Build it yourself ``` ./gradlew assembleDebug # app/build/outputs/apk/debug/ ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest # unit tests ``` You need JDK 17 or newer and an Android SDK with platform 37. Details, release signing and the project layout are in [docs/building.md](docs/building.md). ## Privacy OpenTune has no ads and needs no account. Usage counting sends a random installation ID, the app version and daily play totals; never song names, accounts or listening history. You can turn it off under Settings › About. [What is counted](docs/usage-counts.md) · [Privacy policy](https://justshivv.github.io/Opentune/privacy/) ## Community Questions, ideas and bug reports are welcome on [Discord](https://discord.gg/6udrCVh5n) and in the [issues](https://github.com/justshivv/Opentune/issues). ## Disclaimer The screenshots show real albums, artists and songs to show the app as it's used. Cover art, names and recordings belong to their owners. OpenTune isn't affiliated with or endorsed by YouTube, Google, Spotify or any artist or label shown. ## License OpenTune is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0. See [LICENSE](LICENSE). Code, libraries, fonts and data from other projects are listed in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md), as their licences require.
